en.t: Roman tradition dates Publicola’s triumph to the Kalends of March
en.s: Roman tradition dates a triumph by the consul Publius Valerius Publicola to March 1, 509 BCE, after the Roman victory over Etruscan forces at Silva Arsia. The celebration took place in Rome, in present-day Italy; the date is reported in the Fasti Triumphales tradition.
en.n: This follows traditional Roman chronology and the Roman calendar’s Kalends of March; it is not a securely established conversion to the modern calendar.

zh.t: 罗马传统将普布利科拉的凯旋式记为三月初一
zh.s: 按照罗马传统纪年，执政官普布利乌斯·瓦莱里乌斯·普布利科拉在公元前509年3月1日举行凯旋式，庆祝罗马在阿尔西亚森林击败伊特鲁里亚军队。仪式在今意大利罗马举行，日期见于《凯旋年表》的记载。
zh.n: 此处采用传统罗马纪年和罗马历三月初一，并非已确定换算成现代历法的日期。

en.t: Emperor Diocletian and Maximian appoint Constantius Chlorus and Galerius as Caesars. This is considered the beginning of the Tetrarchy, known as the Quattuor Principes Mundi ("Four Rulers of the World")
en.s: Marcus Flavius Valerius Constantius (c. 250 – 25 July 306), also called Constantius I, was a Roman emperor from 305 to 306—and was father of Constantine the Great, the first Christian emperor of Rome. He was one of the four original members of the Tetrarchy established by Diocletian, first serving as caesar from 293 to 305 and then ruling as augustus until his death.

zh.t: 戴克里先和马克西米安任命君士坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯与伽列里乌斯为凯撒，四帝共治由此开始
zh.s: 马尔库斯·弗拉维乌斯·瓦莱里乌斯·君士坦提乌斯（约250年—306年7月25日），又称君士坦提乌斯一世，是305年至306年的罗马皇帝，也是罗马第一位基督教皇帝君士坦丁大帝的父亲。他是戴克里先建立的四帝共治体制最初四位统治者之一，293年至305年担任凯撒，之后任奥古斯都直至去世。

en.t: Louis the Pious is reconciled with the Church at Saint-Denis
en.s: On March 1, 834, bishops at Saint-Denis in present-day France reconciled Emperor Louis the Pious with the Church and returned royal clothing and weapons to him. The ceremony formed part of his restoration after his deposition in 833.
en.n: This entry records the Saint-Denis reconciliation, rather than a new accession as sole ruler.

zh.t: 虔诚者路易在圣但尼与教会和解
zh.s: 834年3月1日，在今法国圣但尼，主教们使皇帝虔诚者路易与教会和解，并将王室服饰和武器交还给他。这场仪式是他在833年被废黜后恢复地位的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录圣但尼和解，并非首次即位成为唯一统治者。

en.t: University of Coimbra, in Portugal, is officially chartered by King Denis
en.s: The University of Coimbra (UC) is a public research university in Coimbra, Portugal. Officially chartered by King Denis on 1 March 1290, and recognised by Pope Nicholas IV on 9 August 1290, it is the oldest university in Portugal and one of the world's oldest in continuous operations, having begun operations in Lisbon before moving permanently to Coimbra in 1537.

zh.t: 葡萄牙科英布拉大学获迪尼斯国王正式特许
zh.s: 科英布拉大学是一所位于葡萄牙科英布拉的公立研究型大学。1290年3月1日，迪尼斯国王正式颁发特许状；1290年8月9日，教宗尼各老四世予以承认。该校是葡萄牙最古老的大学，也是世界上持续办学历史最悠久的大学之一。学校最初在里斯本办学，1537年永久迁至科英布拉。

en.s: The Battle of Toro was a royal battle from the War of the Castilian Succession, fought on 1 March 1476, near the city of Toro, between the Castilian troops of the Catholic Monarchs and the Portuguese-Castilian forces of Afonso V and Prince John. The battle had an inconclusive military outcome, as both sides claimed victory: the Castilian right wing was defeated by the forces under Prince John who possessed the battlefield, but the troops of Afonso V were beaten by the Castilian left-centre led by the Duke of Alba and Cardinal Mendoza.

zh.s: 1476年3月1日，卡斯蒂利亚王位继承战争期间，天主教双王的卡斯蒂利亚军，与阿方索五世及若昂王子率领的葡萄牙—卡斯蒂利亚联军，在托罗城附近交战。军事结果并不明确，双方均宣称胜利：卡斯蒂利亚右翼被若昂王子的部队击败，王子控制了战场；但阿方索五世的军队，又被阿尔瓦公爵和门多萨枢机率领的卡斯蒂利亚左翼及中军击败。

en.s: The Adil Shahi–Portuguese conflicts were various armed engagements that took place in India between the Portuguese Empire and the Sultanate of Bijapur, ruled by the Adil Shahi dynasty, whose rulers were known to the Portuguese as Hidalcão. The Sultanate of Bijapur was one of the Deccan Sultanates. The Portuguese first clashed with the forces of Bijapur in 1506 at the siege of Angediva.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 阿迪勒沙希王朝与葡萄牙冲突
zh.s: 1506年3月1日至1659年，葡萄牙帝国与印度比贾布尔苏丹国多次交战；最初的冲突发生在安吉迪瓦围城期间。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的冲突开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Salt River was a small military engagement between the crew of a Portuguese fleet led by Francisco de Almeida and the indigenous ǃUriǁʼaekua ("Goringhaiqua" in Dutch approximate spelling), notable for being the first military encounter between Europeans and indigenous people in what would later become South Africa. The battle resulted in a massacre of Portuguese forces and a victory for the ǃUriǁʼaekua.

zh.s: 盐河战役是葡萄牙舰队与当地原住民之间的一场小规模军事冲突。葡萄牙舰队由弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达率领，对手是ǃUriǁʼaekua人（荷兰人近似拼作“Goringhaiqua”）。这是欧洲人与后来成为南非地区的原住民之间首次发生军事冲突。战斗以葡萄牙军队遭屠杀、ǃUriǁʼaekua人获胜告终。

en.s: The Massacre of Vassy (French: massacre de Wassy) was the murder of Huguenot worshippers and citizens in an armed action by troops of the Duke of Guise, in Wassy, France on 1 March 1562. The massacre is identified as the first major event in the French Wars of Religion. The series of battles that followed concluded in the signing of the Peace of Amboise (or Pacification Treaty of Amboise) on 19 March 1563.

zh.s: 1562年3月1日，吉斯公爵的部队在法国瓦西发动武装行动，杀害胡格诺派礼拜者及市民，史称瓦西大屠杀。这被视为法国宗教战争的第一个重大事件。此后的一系列战斗，直到1563年3月19日签署《昂布瓦斯和约》才告结束。

en.s: On March 1, 1656, Swedish forces under Charles X Gustav withdrew from Zamość in present-day Poland after failing to capture its fortified defenses. The withdrawal ended the siege that had begun in February.
en.n: This entry records the withdrawal and end of the siege.

zh.t: 瑞典军队撤离扎莫希奇
zh.s: 1656年3月1日，瑞典国王卡尔十世·古斯塔夫的军队未能攻下今波兰扎莫希奇的防御工事，随后撤退，结束了自2月开始的围城。
zh.n: 此条记录撤军和围城结束。

en.s: The Raid on Nassau took place from 24 February to 1 March 1720, at the end of the 1718 to 1720 War of the Quadruple Alliance. A Spanish expeditionary force attacked the British settlement of Nassau, Bahamas, but was repulsed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拿骚突袭发生于1720年2月24日至3月1日，是1718至1720年四国同盟战争末期的一次行动。西班牙远征军袭击巴哈马群岛的英国定居点拿骚，但被击退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Siege of Fort Augustus took place from 22 February to 1 March 1746, during the Jacobite rising of 1745. After a short siege, the government garrison surrendered to a Jacobite force, which then moved on to besiege Fort William, using artillery captured at Fort Augustus.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥古斯都堡围城战发生于1746年2月22日至3月1日，是1745年詹姆斯党起义期间的一场战斗。短暂围城后，政府军守军投降于詹姆斯党军队。后者随后使用在奥古斯都堡缴获的火炮，继续围攻威廉堡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Aldenhoven (1 March 1793) saw the Habsburg Austrian army commanded by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld attack a Republican French force under René Joseph de Lanoue. The Austrians successfully crossed the Roer River and engaged in a cavalry charge led by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen which routed the French and inflicted heavy losses. The War of the First Coalition battle occurred near Aldenhoven, a city in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany located about 55 kilometres (34 mi) west of Cologne. After a victory in the Battle of Jemappes on 6 November 1792, the French army of Charles Francois Dumouriez conquered most of the Austrian Netherlands.

zh.s: 1793年3月1日，萨克森—科堡—萨尔费尔德的约西亚斯亲王率哈布斯堡奥地利军队，攻击勒内·约瑟夫·德拉努指挥的法国共和军。奥军成功渡过鲁尔河，特申公爵卡尔大公率骑兵冲锋，击溃法军并造成重大损失。此战属于第一次反法同盟战争，地点在今德国北莱茵—威斯特法伦州阿尔登霍芬附近，距科隆以西约55公里，即34英里。此前，夏尔·弗朗索瓦·迪穆里埃的法军于1792年11月6日赢得热马普战役，征服了奥属尼德兰大部分地区。

en.s: The Battle of Saint-Julien (1 March 1814) saw Imperial French troops led by Jean Gabriel Marchand attack Austrian soldiers under Johann Nepomuk von Klebelsberg. In tough fighting, the Austrians managed to hold off persistent French assaults during this War of the Sixth Coalition clash. The next day, the Austrians withdrew within the defenses of Geneva, a distance of 9 kilometres (6 mi) to the northeast. The battle was part of operations in which a French army led by Marshal Pierre Augereau squared off against Austrian forces under Ferdinand, Graf Bubna von Littitz.

zh.s: 1814年3月1日，第六次反法同盟战争期间，让·加布里埃尔·马尔尚率法国帝国军，攻击约翰·内波穆克·冯·克莱贝尔斯贝格指挥的奥军。激战中，奥军挡住法军接连进攻，翌日退入东北方向约9公里、即6英里外的日内瓦防御工事。此战属于皮埃尔·奥热罗元帅率法军，对抗费迪南德·布布纳·冯·利蒂茨伯爵所部奥军的一系列行动。

en.s: The Battle of Llano El Espino was a military confrontation fought between troops of the Province of San Salvador (present El Salvador) and the Captaincy General of Central America (First Mexican Empire) on March 1, 1822.

zh.t: 埃尔埃斯皮诺平原战役
zh.s: 1822年3月1日，圣萨尔瓦多省，也就是今萨尔瓦多的部队，与墨西哥第一帝国所属中美洲都督府部队，在埃尔埃斯皮诺平原交战。

en.t: The Ragamuffin War ends with the Peace of Ponche Verde
en.s: On March 1, 1845, the Ragamuffin War in southern Brazil ended with the Peace of Ponche Verde, which provided amnesty and terms for reintegrating the rebel leaders.
en.n: This entry records the peace settlement and end of the war, rather than the start of the uprising in 1835.

zh.t: 法拉波斯战争随蓬切韦尔德和议结束
zh.s: 1845年3月1日，巴西南部的法拉波斯战争随蓬切韦尔德和议结束。和议为叛军领袖规定了赦免和重新融入国家的条件。
zh.n: 此条记录达成和议及战争结束，并非1835年起义爆发。

en.s: The Plan of Ayutla was the 1854 written plan aimed at removing conservative, centralist President Antonio López de Santa Anna from control of Mexico during the Second Federal Republic of Mexico period. Initially, it seemed little different from other political plans of the era, but it is considered to be the first act of the Liberal Reform in Mexico.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿尤特拉计划是1854年提出的一项书面计划，旨在推翻墨西哥第二联邦共和国时期的保守派中央集权总统安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安纳。起初，这项计划看起来与当时其他政治计划相差不大，但后来被视为墨西哥自由改革的开端。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: In the 1859 Chicago mayoral election, incumbent Republican John Charles Haines defeated Democratic challenger Marcus D. Gilman. The election was held on March 1.

zh.s: 在1859年芝加哥市长选举中，现任共和党市长约翰·查尔斯·海因斯击败了民主党挑战者马库斯·D·吉尔曼。选举于3月1日举行。

en.s: The Battle of Mrzyglod took place on March 1, 1863 near the village of Mrzyglod (now a district of Myszkow), Russian-controlled Congress Poland. It was one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, the anti-Russian rebellion of Poles. The battle resulted in Polish victory. After a skirmish near the village of Panki, a party of Polish insurgents under Teodor Cieszkowski came to the town of Mrzyglod, on February 28, 1863. The Russians, tipped by their informers, transferred here a unit of the Imperial Russian Army, which arrived at Mrzyglod by the Warsaw–Vienna railway.

zh.s: 1863年3月1日，俄国控制的波兰会议王国姆日格武德村附近发生战斗，是一月起义中波兰人反俄的众多小规模交战之一，波军获胜。该村今属梅什库夫市。此前，泰奥多尔·切什科夫斯基率起义部队在潘基村附近交战后，于2月28日抵达姆日格武德。俄方获得线人通报，调来一支帝国陆军部队，经华沙—维也纳铁路抵达当地。

en.s: The Skirmish at Cedar Creek, also known as Camp Mooney or McGirt's Creek, was a small engagement of the American Civil War fought in present-day Jacksonville, Florida on March 1, 1864. It was fought between a small Confederate States Army outpost and the 40th Massachusetts Volunteer Infantry of the Union Army, and resulted in 29 casualties. It was the last engagement in the Olustee Campaign.

zh.s: 1864年3月1日，美国南北战争期间，今佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔发生锡达溪交战，又称穆尼营或麦吉尔特溪交战。邦联陆军一处小型哨站与联邦军马萨诸塞第40志愿步兵团交战，共造成29人伤亡。这是奥拉斯蒂战事的最后一场交战。

en.s: The Paraguayan War, also known as the War of the Triple Alliance and the Great War in Paraguay, was a South American war fought from 1864 to 1870 between Paraguay and the Triple Alliance of Argentina, the Empire of Brazil, and Uruguay. With an estimated 400,000 deaths, the war was the deadliest and bloodiest in Latin America's history. It particularly devastated Paraguay, which suffered catastrophic losses in population - almost 70% of its adult male population died, according to some counts - and was forced to cede territory to Argentina and Brazil.

zh.s: 巴拉圭战争，又称三国同盟战争，在巴拉圭也称“大战”，于1864年至1870年在南美洲进行。巴拉圭对抗阿根廷、巴西帝国和乌拉圭组成的三国同盟，估计共40万人死亡，是拉丁美洲历史上死亡最多、最血腥的战争。巴拉圭遭受尤其严重的人口损失，据部分统计，近70%的成年男性死亡，并被迫向阿根廷及巴西割让领土。

en.s: The Battle of Cerro Corá (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsero koˈɾa]) was the last major battle of the Paraguayan War, fought on 1 March 1870, in the vicinity of Cerro Corá, 454 kilometres (280 mi) northeast of Paraguay's capital Asunción. It is known for being the battle in which Francisco Solano López, Paraguayan president, was killed at the hands of the Imperial Brazilian Army.

zh.s: 塞罗科拉战役（西班牙语发音：[ˈsero koˈɾa]）是巴拉圭战争的最后一场重大战役，于1870年3月1日在塞罗科拉附近爆发，地点在巴拉圭首都亚松森东北454公里（280英里）处。巴拉圭总统弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯在战斗中被巴西帝国军杀死。

en.s: The Campaign of the Hills (Spanish: Campaña de las Cordilleras) was the last campaign of the Paraguayan War, lasting from July 1869 to the end of the war on March 1, 1870. The Paraguayans were completely defeated by the Allies. Brazilian writer Alfredo d'Escragnolle Taunay, Viscount of Taunay took part in the campaign and later wrote about it. At least 5,000 Paraguayans were killed during this campaign.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 山地战役（西班牙语：Campaña de las Cordilleras）是巴拉圭战争的最后一场战役，从1869年7月持续到1870年3月1日战争结束。巴拉圭军队被盟军彻底击败。巴西作家阿尔弗雷多·德斯克拉尼奥尔·陶奈子爵曾参加这场战役，后来写下相关经历。战役期间至少有5,000名巴拉圭人阵亡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On March 1, 1871, German troops paraded through Paris, France, after the Franco-Prussian War armistice. They marched along the Champs-Élysées and occupied the Place de la Concorde during a brief, symbolic occupation.

zh.t: 德军在巴黎举行胜利游行
zh.s: 1871年3月1日，普法战争停战后，德军在法国巴黎举行游行。他们沿香榭丽舍大街行进，并占据协和广场，对巴黎进行了短暂的象征性占领。

en.t: Grant signs the law establishing Yellowstone National Park
en.s: On March 1, 1872, U.S. President Ulysses S. Grant signed the Yellowstone National Park Protection Act into law, establishing Yellowstone as the world’s first national park.
en.n: This entry records the signing of the law establishing the park.

zh.t: 格兰特签署法案，设立黄石国家公园
zh.s: 1872年3月1日，美国总统尤利西斯·S·格兰特签署《黄石国家公园保护法》，设立黄石国家公园，使其成为世界上第一个国家公园。
zh.n: 此条记录设立公园的法律签署。

en.s: The Battle of Zhenhai (Chinese: 镇海之役) was a minor confrontation that took place on 1 March 1885 between Admiral Amédée Courbet's Far East Squadron (escadre de l’extrême-Orient) and Chinese warships and shore batteries near the coastal city of Zhenhai, 12 miles (19 km) downstream from Ningbo, China during the Sino-French War (August 1884 – April 1885). French and Chinese sources disagree sharply as to what happened; French sources treat the encounter as a minor incident, while Chinese sources consider it a striking defensive victory. The Battle of Zhenhai is still commemorated in China as an important Chinese victory in the Sino-French War.

zh.s: 1885年3月1日，中法战争期间，孤拔海军上将率法国远东舰队，与镇海附近的中国军舰和岸防炮台发生小规模交锋。镇海位于宁波下游约12英里，即19公里处。对于战斗经过，法中史料分歧很大：法国记述将其视为一次小事件，中国记述则认为这是显著的防御胜利。镇海之战在中国仍作为中法战争中的重要胜利受到纪念。

en.s: The Huaraz Rebellion was an insurrection started in 1885 by indigenous peasants against the Peruvian Republic. The cause for the conflict was the reestablishment of the indigenous tribute by the government of President Miguel Iglesias.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瓦拉斯起义是1885年秘鲁原住民农民反抗秘鲁共和国而发动的一场起义。冲突起因是米格尔·伊格莱西亚斯总统领导的政府恢复了针对原住民的贡赋制度。

en.s: The Battle of Adwa (also known as Adowa, or sometimes by the Italian name Adua) was fought on 1 March 1896 between the Ethiopian Empire and the Kingdom of Italy near the town of Adwa, Ethiopia, in Tigray. It was the climactic battle of the First Italo-Ethiopian War, securing Ethiopian sovereignty. As the 20th century approached, most of Africa had been carved up among the European powers. The two independent exceptions were the young Republic of Liberia on the west coast of the continent and the Ethiopian Empire in the strategic Horn of Africa.

zh.s: 1896年3月1日，埃塞俄比亚帝国与意大利王国在埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区阿杜瓦镇附近交战。阿杜瓦战役是第一次意埃战争的关键一战，确保了埃塞俄比亚的主权。20世纪即将到来时，非洲大部分地区已被欧洲列强瓜分，仍独立的两个例外，是大陆西岸年轻的利比里亚共和国，以及位于非洲之角战略位置的埃塞俄比亚帝国。阿杜瓦也有阿多瓦、阿杜阿等译名。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1898 was the ninth general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on March 1, 1898, to elect the 94 Members of the 9th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Arthur S. Hardy, won an eighth term in office with a clear majority – the Patrons of Industry and the Protestant Protective Association held no sway in this legislature. The Ontario Conservative Party, led by Sir James P. Whitney, formed the official opposition.

zh.s: 1898年3月1日，加拿大安大略省举行第九次大选，选出第九届省议会94名议员。阿瑟·S.哈迪领导的安大略自由党以明确多数赢得第八个执政任期，工业保护者党和新教保护协会在这一届议会已无影响力。詹姆斯·P.惠特尼爵士领导的安大略保守党成为官方反对党。

en.s: The Kronstadt rebellion (Russian: Кронштадтское восстание, romanized: Kronshtadtskoye vosstaniye) was a 1921 insurrection of Soviet sailors, naval infantry, and civilians against the Bolshevik government in the Russian port city of Kronstadt. Located on Kotlin Island in the Gulf of Finland, Kronstadt defended the former capital city, Petrograd (now Saint Petersburg), as the base of the Baltic Fleet.

zh.s: 喀琅施塔得起义（俄语：Кронштадтское восстание，罗马字：Kronshtadtskoye vosstaniye）是1921年苏联水兵、海军步兵和平民反抗布尔什维克政府的一场起义，地点在俄国港口城市喀琅施塔得。喀琅施塔得位于芬兰湾的科特林岛上，是波罗的海舰队基地，守卫着当时的首都彼得格勒（今圣彼得堡）。

en.t: The Australian cricket team, led by Warwick Armstrong, became the first team to complete a whitewash in the Ashes, an achievement that would not be repeated for 86 years
en.s: Warwick Windridge Armstrong (22 May 1879 – 13 July 1947) was an Australian cricketer who played 50 Test matches between 1902 and 1921. An all-rounder, he captained Australia in ten Test matches between 1920 and 1921, and was undefeated, winning eight Tests and drawing two. Armstrong was captain of the 1920–21 Australian team which defeated the touring English 5–0: one of only three teams to win an Ashes series in a whitewash.

zh.t: 沃里克·阿姆斯特朗率领的澳大利亚板球队成为首支在灰烬杯系列赛中横扫对手的球队
zh.s: 沃里克·温德里奇·阿姆斯特朗（1879年5月22日—1947年7月13日）是澳大利亚板球运动员，1902年至1921年间参加了50场测试赛。他是全能型球员，1920至1921年间担任澳大利亚队队长，参加10场测试赛，取得8胜2平的不败战绩。他率领澳大利亚队在1920至1921赛季以5比0横扫来访的英格兰队；此前只有另外两支球队在灰烬杯系列赛中横扫获胜。

en.t: Bulgaria accedes to the Tripartite Pact in Vienna

zh.t: 保加利亚在维也纳加入《三国同盟条约》

en.t: Second Battle of the Java Sea
en.s: The Second Battle of the Java Sea was the last naval action of the Netherlands East Indies campaign, of 1941–42. It occurred on 1 March 1942, two days after the first Battle of the Java Sea. It saw the end of the last Allied warships operating in the waters around Java, allowing Japanese forces to complete their conquest of the Dutch East Indies unhindered.

zh.s: 第二次爪哇海海战是1941至1942年荷属东印度群岛战役中的最后一场海战，发生于1942年3月1日，也就是第一次爪哇海海战两天后。盟军在爪哇附近海域作战的最后一批军舰在这场战斗中被击沉或失去战斗力，使日军得以不受阻碍地完成对荷属东印度群岛的征服。

en.s: The Battle of Sunda Strait was a naval battle which occurred during World War II in the Sunda Strait between the islands of Java, and Sumatra. On the night of 28 February – 1 March 1942, the Australian light cruiser HMAS Perth, American heavy cruiser USS Houston, and Dutch destroyer HNLMS Evertsen faced a major Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) task force.

en.s: The Battle of Steamroller Farm took place during the Second World War between 26 February and 1 March 1943, during the Tunisian campaign, in which the Western Allies defeated the Axis powers and ended the war in North Africa. The battle was the result of a German attempt to launch an attack against the advancing British First Army in order to buy time for an attack on the British Eight Army on the Mareth line.

zh.s: 蒸汽压路机农场战役发生于1943年2月26日至3月1日，是突尼斯战役的一部分。西方盟军在突尼斯战役中击败轴心国，结束了轴心国在北非的战争。德军试图袭击正在推进的英国第一集团军，为对英国第八集团军在马雷斯防线发动进攻争取时间，由此引发这场战斗。

en.s: This is a sub-article to Leningrad–Novgorod Offensive and Battle of Narva. The Kingisepp–Gdov offensive was a campaign between the Soviet Leningrad Front and the German 18th Army fought for the eastern coast of Lake Peipus and the western banks of the Narva River from 1 February till 1 March 1944. The 109th Rifle Corps captured the town of Kingisepp, forcing the 18th Army into new positions on the eastern bank of the Narva.

zh.s: 金吉谢普—格多夫攻势是列宁格勒—诺夫哥罗德攻势和纳尔瓦战役的相关战役之一。1944年2月1日至3月1日，苏联列宁格勒方面军与德国第18集团军在佩皮湖东岸和纳尔瓦河西岸交战。苏军第109步兵军攻占金吉谢普，迫使德军第18集团军转移到纳尔瓦河东岸的新阵地。

en.s: The Huon Peninsula campaign was a series of battles fought in north-eastern Papua New Guinea in 1943–1944 during the Second World War. The campaign formed the initial part of an offensive that the Allies launched in the Pacific in late 1943 and resulted in the Japanese being pushed north from Lae to Sio on the northern coast of New Guinea over the course of a four-month period.

zh.s: 休恩半岛战役是第二次世界大战期间，1943至1944年在巴布亚新几内亚东北部进行的一系列战斗。它是盟军1943年末在太平洋发动攻势的第一阶段。战役持续约四个月，日军被逐步向北赶出莱城，退至新几内亚北岸的西奥。

en.s: The Battle of Schoenfeld (Polish: Szarża pod Borujskiem) took place on 1 March 1945 during World War II and was the scene of the last mounted charge in the history of the Polish cavalry. The Polish charge overran German defensive positions and forced a German retreat from the village of Schoenfeld (today known as Żeńsko, formerly known in Polish as Borujsko).

zh.s: 舍恩费尔德战役（波兰语：Szarża pod Borujskiem）发生于1945年3月1日，是第二次世界大战中波兰骑兵最后一次冲锋。波兰骑兵冲破德军防线，迫使德军撤出舍恩费尔德村；该村现名热恩斯科，过去的波兰语名为博鲁伊斯科。

en.s: The General Offensive of 1 March 1949 (Indonesian: Serangan Umum 1 Maret 1949; Javanese: ꦱꦺꦫꦤ꧀ꦒꦤ꧀ ꦈꦩꦸꦩ꧀ ꧇꧑꧇ ꦩꦫꦺꦠ꧀ ꧇꧑꧙꧔꧙; Dutch: Algemeen offensief van 1 maart 1949) was a military offensive during the Indonesian National Revolution where the city of Yogyakarta was held by Indonesian troops for six hours. This played an important role in causing international pressure to be exerted on the Netherlands.

zh.s: 1949年3月1日总攻（印度尼西亚语：Serangan Umum 1 Maret 1949；爪哇语：ꦱꦺꦫꦤ꧀ꦒꦤ꧀ ꦈꦩꦸꦩ꧀ ꧇꧑꧇ ꦩꦫꦺꦠ꧀ ꧇꧑꧙꧔꧙；荷兰语：Algemeen offensief van 1 maart 1949）是印度尼西亚民族革命期间的一次军事攻势。印度尼西亚军队在日惹控制了该市六个小时。这次行动促使国际社会向荷兰施压，发挥了重要作用。

en.t: Chiang Kai-shek resumes the presidency in Taipei
en.s: On March 1, 1950, Chiang Kai-shek resumed the powers of the Republic of China presidency in Taipei, Taiwan. He had stepped down in January 1949, when Vice President Li Zongren became acting president.

zh.t: 蒋介石在台北恢复行使总统职权

en.s: On March 1, 1954, four Puerto Rican nationalists, seeking to promote Puerto Rican independence from the United States, attacked the United States Capitol. They fired 30 rounds from semi-automatic pistols onto the legislative floor from the Ladies' Gallery (a balcony for visitors) of the House of Representatives chamber within the United States Capitol.

zh.s: 1954年3月1日，四名波多黎各民族主义者为推动波多黎各脱离美国独立，袭击了美国国会大厦。他们从众议院议事厅访客席（供访客使用的阳台）向议员席开枪，共射出30发半自动手枪子弹。

en.t: 1957 Indian general election in Madras State
en.s: The 1957 Indian general election polls in Tamil Nadu were held for 34 seats in the state. The result was a victory for Indian National Congress winning 24 out of 34 seats. The major opposition for INC, the CPI, managed to only win 2 seats. This election also saw the entry of Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam in their first national election, who ended up winning 2 seats.

zh.s: 1957年印度大选期间，泰米尔纳德邦（当时为马德拉斯邦）改选34个席位。印度国民大会党赢得24席，获得胜利。其主要对手印度共产党只赢得2席。达罗毗荼进步联盟首次参加全国大选，也赢得2席。

en.s: The Peace Corps is an independent agency and program of the United States government that trains and deploys volunteers to communities in partner countries around the world. It was established in March 1961 by an executive order (10924) of President John F. Kennedy and authorized by the United States Congress the following September by the Peace Corps Act on September 22, 1961.
en.n: On March 1, 1961, Kennedy signed Executive Order 10924 that officially started the Peace Corps.

zh.s: 和平队是美国政府的一个独立机构和项目，负责培训志愿者，并派他们前往世界各地的伙伴国家社区服务。1961年3月，约翰·F·肯尼迪总统签署第10924号行政命令，设立和平队；同年9月22日，美国国会通过《和平队法》正式授权该项目。
zh.n: 1961年3月1日，肯尼迪签署第10924号行政命令，正式启动和平队。

en.s: American Airlines Flight 1 was a regularly scheduled passenger flight from New York International (Idlewild) Airport (now John F. Kennedy International Airport) in New York City to Los Angeles International Airport in Los Angeles. During takeoff on March 1, 1962, the Boeing 707 rolled over and crashed into Jamaica Bay in New York City two minutes after taking off, killing all 87 passengers and eight crew members aboard.

zh.t: 美国航空1号班机空难（1962年）
zh.s: 美国航空1号班机是一趟定期客运航班，从纽约国际机场（艾德怀德机场，现约翰·F·肯尼迪国际机场）飞往洛杉矶国际机场。1962年3月1日，波音707客机起飞时翻转，离地两分钟后坠入纽约市牙买加湾。机上87名乘客和8名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: Paradise Airlines Flight 901A was a scheduled passenger flight from San Jose Municipal Airport to Tahoe Valley Airport, both within California, United States. On March 1, 1964, the Lockheed L-049 Constellation serving the flight crashed near Genoa Peak, on the eastern side of Lake Tahoe during a heavy snowstorm, killing all 85 aboard. After the crash site was located, the recovery of the wreckage and the bodies of the victims took most of a month.

zh.s: 天堂航空901A号班机是往返美国加利福尼亚州圣何塞市立机场与塔霍谷机场之间的定期客运航班。1964年3月1日，执飞的一架洛克希德L-049“星座”客机，在猛烈暴风雪中坠毁于塔霍湖东侧热那亚峰附近，机上85人全部遇难。找到坠机地点后，回收残骸和遇难者遗体花了将近一个月。

en.s: General elections were held in the Bechuanaland Protectorate on 1 March 1965, the country's first election under universal suffrage. The result was a landslide victory for the Bechuanaland Democratic Party (BDP), with Seretse Khama becoming Prime Minister. Following the elections, the country became independent as Botswana on 30 September 1966, at which point Khama became President.

zh.s: 1965年3月1日，贝专纳兰保护国举行大选，这是该国首次实行普选。贝专纳兰民主党大获全胜，塞雷茨·卡马出任总理。该国于1966年9月30日独立，成为博茨瓦纳，卡马随后出任总统。

en.s: General elections were held in British Honduras (now Belize) on 1 March 1965. Belizeans elected 18 members to the British Honduras Legislative Assembly. The ruling People's United Party (PUP) won 16 of 18 seats in the elections. However, the opposition National Independence Party entered the Legislative Assembly for the first time in the election, with party leader Philip Goldson winning in the Albert constituency and Edwin Morey winning in Toledo North.

zh.s: 1965年3月1日，英属洪都拉斯（今伯利兹）举行大选，选出立法议会18名议员。执政的人民联合党赢得18席中的16席。反对党国家独立党首次进入议会，党魁菲利普·戈尔德森赢得阿尔伯特选区，埃德温·莫里赢得托莱多北选区。

en.s: Operation Coburg (24 January − 1 March 1968) was an Australian and New Zealand military action during the Vietnam War. The operation saw heavy fighting between the 1st Australian Task Force (1 ATF) and North Vietnamese Army and Viet Cong during the wider fighting around Long Binh and Bien Hoa. American and South Vietnamese intelligence reports had indicated that an imminent communist offensive during the Tet New Year festival was likely, and in response the Australians and New Zealanders were deployed away from their base in Phuoc Tuy Province to bolster American and South Vietnamese forces defending the Long Binh–Bien Hoa complex north-east of Saigon.

zh.s: “科堡行动”是越南战争期间澳大利亚与新西兰军队于1968年1月24日至3月1日开展的军事行动。龙平和边和周边爆发大范围战斗，澳大利亚第一特遣队与北越军及越共激烈交战。美国及南越情报显示，共产党方面很可能在春节发动攻势，因此澳新部队离开福绥省基地，支援守卫西贡东北龙平—边和设施群的美国和南越军队。

en.s: The Battle of Valle Giulia is the conventional name for a clash between Italian left-wing militants and the Italian police at Valle Giulia, Rome, on 1 March 1968. It is still frequently remembered as one of the first violent clashes in Italy's student unrest during the protests of 1968 (the Sessantotto, sixty-eight).

zh.s: 1968年3月1日，意大利左翼激进人士与警察在罗马朱利亚谷发生冲突，通常被称为朱利亚谷之战。这仍经常被视为意大利1968年学生抗议浪潮中，最早发生的暴力冲突之一。

en.s: The action of 1 March 1968 was a co-ordinated attempt by four North Vietnamese trawlers to resupply the Viet Cong and the efforts of Operation Market Time elements to stop them during the Vietnam War. On 28 February 1968, United States Navy SP-2H Neptune aircraft on routine patrol detected a North Vietnamese SL class naval trawler heading towards the South Vietnamese coast from north of the DMZ.

zh.s: 1968年3月1日，四艘北越拖网渔船试图协同向越共运送补给，美国海军“市场时间行动”部队则试图拦截。这次行动发生在越南战争期间。1968年2月28日，美国海军例行巡逻的SP-2H“海王星”飞机发现一艘北越SL级海军拖网渔船正从非军事区以北驶向南越海岸。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 1 March 1970. The result was a victory for the Social Democratic Party, which won 81 of the 165 seats to become the largest party for the first time in the Second Republic. Bruno Kreisky of the Social Democrats became Chancellor at the head of a minority government that was tolerated by the Freedom Party of Austria in return for electoral reform that favoured smaller parties. Voter turnout was 91.8%. It was the first Socialist-led government since 1920, and the first purely left-wing government in Austrian history.

zh.s: 奥地利于1970年3月1日举行议会选举。社会民主党在165席中赢得81席，首次成为第二共和国第一大党。布鲁诺·克赖斯基出任总理，领导少数派政府；奥地利自由党容许其执政，换取有利于小党的选举改革。投票率为91.8%。这是1920年以来首个由社会党人领导的政府，也是奥地利历史上首个完全由左翼组成的政府。

en.s: General elections were held in Guatemala on 1 March 1970. No candidate received over 50% of the vote in the presidential election, resulting in Carlos Manuel Arana Osorio being elected by Congress on 21 March. The National Liberation Movement-Institutional Democratic Party alliance won the Congressional elections. Voter turnout was 53.82% in the presidential election and 53.26% in the Congressional elections.

zh.s: 危地马拉于1970年3月1日举行大选。总统投票中没有候选人获得超过50%的选票，因此国会于3月21日选举卡洛斯·曼努埃尔·阿拉纳·奥索里奥出任总统。民族解放运动与制度民主党组成的联盟赢得国会选举。总统选举投票率为53.82%，国会选举为53.26%。

zh.s: 1973年3月1日，英国下议院切斯特勒斯特里特选区举行议会补选。

en.s: The Lincoln by-election of 1 March 1973 saw the re-election of Dick Taverne as Member of Parliament for Lincoln as a Democratic Labour representative, after Taverne's pro-Common Market views saw him repudiated by the Lincoln Constituency Labour Party. The by-election led to considerable speculation, stoked by Taverne, about the formation of a new centre party, but Taverne was unable to make his victory last.

zh.s: 1973年3月1日，迪克·塔弗恩以民主工党代表身份，在林肯选区补选中再次当选英国议员。他支持欧洲共同市场的立场，此前遭林肯选区工党组织否定。塔弗恩本人也推波助澜，这场胜利引发外界对成立新中间派政党的大量猜测，但他未能让胜选带来的优势持续下去。

en.t: Attack on the Saudi Embassy in Khartoum
en.s: An attack on the Saudi embassy in Khartoum took place on 1 March 1973. It was carried out by the Black September Organization. Ten diplomats from several countries were taken hostage. After President Richard Nixon stated that he refused to negotiate with terrorists, and insisted that "no concessions" would be made, one Belgian and two U.S. hostages were killed.

zh.t: 沙特阿拉伯驻喀土穆大使馆遇袭
zh.s: 1973年3月1日，“黑色九月”组织袭击沙特阿拉伯驻喀土穆大使馆，劫持来自数个国家的10名外交官。美国总统理查德·尼克松表示拒绝与恐怖分子谈判，坚持“不作让步”后，一名比利时人质和两名美国人质被杀。

en.s: The 1975 Football League Cup final took place on 1 March 1975 at the old Wembley Stadium. It was contested between Aston Villa and Norwich City. To date it is the only major domestic cup final played at Wembley Stadium between two clubs outside the top-flight (although both teams were promoted at the end of the season).

zh.s: 1975年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于1975年3月1日在旧温布利球场举行，由阿斯顿维拉对阵诺维奇城。迄今为止，这是唯一一场在温布利举行、两支参赛球队当时都不在顶级联赛的国内重要杯赛决赛；不过两队都在赛季结束时升入顶级联赛。

en.s: The 1979 Spanish general election was held on Thursday, 1 March 1979, to elect the 1st Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 218 seats in the Senate. The Union of the Democratic Centre remained the largest party, winning 168 of the 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies and 119 of the 218 seats in the Senate, as such they continued in minority government.

zh.s: 西班牙于1979年3月1日星期四举行大选，选出王国第一届议会，改选众议院全部350席，以及参议院218席中的208席。民主中间联盟取得众议院168席、参议院119席，继续保持第一大党地位，并以少数派政府形式执政。

en.s: The 1980 OFC Nations Cup final was an association football match that took place on 1 March 1980 at Nouméa Stadium, Nouméa. It was the final match of the 1980 OFC Nations Cup which was the second edition of the OFC Nations Cup, a competition for national teams in the Oceania Football Confederation. It was contested by Australia and Tahiti.

en.s: Elections to the Puducherry Legislative Assembly were held in March 1980, to elect members of the 30 constituencies in Puducherry (then known as Pondicherry), in India. en.s: On March 1, 1982, the Soviet Venera 13 lander reached the surface of Venus. Its television camera transmitted images forming part of the first color panoramic view from the planet’s surface.
en.n: The landing occurred on Venus, outside the countries and continents of Earth.

zh.s: 1982年3月1日，苏联“金星13号”的着陆器降落在金星表面。它的电视摄像机传回图像，组成了金星表面的首幅彩色全景图的一部分。
zh.n: 着陆发生在金星，不属于地球上的任何国家或大洲。

en.s: The 1983 Tampa mayoral election took place on March 1, 1983. Incumbent Mayor Bob Martinez ran for re-election to a second term. He was opposed by jeweler Armando Valdes, who had previously run for mayor several times. Martinez, who was personally popular and had significantly outraised Valdes, spent most of the campaign advocating and campaigning for a referendum to create district seats on the City Council.

zh.s: 美国坦帕于1983年3月1日举行市长选举。现任市长鲍勃·马丁内斯争取第二个任期，对手是曾多次参选的珠宝商阿曼多·巴尔德斯。马丁内斯个人声望较高，筹款也远超对手，因此竞选期间主要精力放在推动一项公投，主张在市议会设置分区议席。

en.s: The 1983 Burlington, Vermont mayoral election was held March 1, 1983. Incumbent Mayor Bernie Sanders won with 52.12% of the popular vote against Democratic nominee Judith Stephany and Republican nominee James Gilson. The Democratic Party unsuccessfully sought to give its mayoral nomination to multiple politicians before choosing Stephany, who had launched her campaign hours before the selection caucus.

zh.t: 1983年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 1983年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举于1983年3月1日举行。现任市长伯尼·桑德斯以52.12%的普选票获胜，击败民主党候选人朱迪思·斯蒂芬妮和共和党候选人詹姆斯·吉尔森。民主党曾试图提名多名政治人物，最终选定斯蒂芬妮；她在党内提名会议开始前数小时才宣布参选。

en.t: The 33rd Berlin International Film Festival closes
en.s: On March 1, 1983, the 33rd Berlin International Film Festival closed in Berlin, in present-day Germany. The festival had opened on February 18; its Golden Bear was shared by Ascendancy and La colmena.

zh.t: 第33届柏林国际电影节闭幕
zh.s: 1983年3月1日，第33届柏林国际电影节在今德国柏林闭幕。电影节于2月18日开幕，金熊奖由《Ascendancy》和《蜂巢》共同获得。
zh.n: 此条记录电影节闭幕日。

en.s: The Chesterfield by-election, 1984 was held on 1 March 1984 for a seat in the House of Commons of the United Kingdom to represent Chesterfield in Derbyshire. This followed the resignation of the sitting Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Eric Varley. The eventual winner, former Labour cabinet minister Tony Benn (who had been ousted from parliament at the general election nine months earlier) defeated sixteen other candidates, at the time the largest fielded in a British by-election — surpassing the previous high of twelve, at the Croydon North West by-election, 1981. This record would not be broken until the Newbury by-election, 1993.

zh.s: 1984年3月1日，英国德比郡切斯特菲尔德选区举行下议院补选，填补工党议员埃里克·瓦利辞职留下的空缺。九个月前大选落败、失去议席的前工党内阁大臣托尼·本恩，击败另外16名候选人当选。17人参选创下当时英国补选纪录，超过1981年克罗伊登西北补选的12人纪录，直到1993年纽伯里补选才再次被打破。

en.s: The Mullacreevie ambush took place on 1 March 1991, when a mobile patrol of the Ulster Defence Regiment composed of two Land Rover vehicles was attacked by a Provisional IRA active service unit with an improvised horizontal mortar while passing near Mullacreevie housing estate, on the west side of Armagh City. One member of the UDR was killed instantly when the leading Land Rover was hit, while another died of wounds two days later. Two other soldiers were permanently injured.

zh.s: 1991年3月1日，阿尔斯特防卫团一支由两辆路虎车组成的巡逻队，经过阿马市西侧马拉克里维住宅区附近时，遭爱尔兰共和军临时派行动小组以自制水平发射迫击炮袭击。前车被击中，一名士兵当场死亡，另一人两天后伤重不治，另两名士兵留下永久性伤残。

en.s: The 1991 Iraqi uprisings were ethnic and religious uprisings against Saddam Hussein's Ba'athist regime that were mainly led by Shia rebels and Kurds. The uprisings lasted from March to April 1991 after a ceasefire following the end of the Gulf War. The mostly uncoordinated insurgency was fueled by the perception that Iraqi President Saddam Hussein had become vulnerable to regime change.

zh.s: 1991年伊拉克起义是针对萨达姆·侯赛因复兴党政权的民族和宗教起义，主要由什叶派反叛者和库尔德人领导。海湾战争结束并停火后，起义从1991年3月持续到4月。由于许多人认为萨达姆政权可能被推翻，这场缺乏统一协调的起义由此爆发。

zh.s: 1995年3月1日，台湾正式实施全民健康保险。这是一项强制参保、由单一保险机构管理的社会医疗保险制度。

en.s: La Copa Junior (1996) (Spanish for "The Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament ran from February 23, 1996 to March 1, 1996 in Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.

en.s: The Rey de Reyes 1998 (Spanish for "King of Kings") was the second annual Rey de Reyes professional wrestling tournament and show, produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA). The event took place on March 1, 1998 in the Toreo de Cuatro Caminos arena in Naucalpan, Mexico State, Mexico. The Rey de Reyes tournament consisted of a semi-final round of four four-man elimination matches and a final match with the winners of each of the semi-finals facing off in an elimination match until only one man remained.

en.s: STS-109 (Hubble Servicing Mission 3B 'SM3B') was a Space Shuttle mission that launched from the Kennedy Space Center on 1 March 2002. It was the 108th mission of the Space Shuttle program, the 27th flight of the orbiter Columbia and the fourth servicing of the Hubble Space Telescope. It was also the penultimate mission of the orbiter Columbia before the STS-107 mission, which was destroyed during re-entry in the Columbia disaster.

zh.s: STS-109（哈勃望远镜维修任务3B）是一次航天飞机任务，于2002年3月1日从肯尼迪航天中心发射。它是航天飞机计划的第108次任务、哥伦比亚号轨道飞行器的第27次飞行，也是哈勃太空望远镜的第四次维修任务。STS-107任务前，这是哥伦比亚号的倒数第二次飞行；哥伦比亚号后来在返回地球时于事故中解体。

en.s: Operation Anaconda or the Battle of Shah-i-Kot was a military operation that took place in early March 2002 as part of the war in Afghanistan. CIA paramilitary officers, working with their allies, attempted to destroy al-Qaeda and Taliban forces. The operation took place in the Shah-i-Kot Valley and Arma Mountains southeast of Zormat. This operation was the first large-scale battle in the post-2001 war in Afghanistan since the Battle of Tora Bora in December 2001.
en.n: U.S. invasion of Afghanistan: Operation Anaconda begins in eastern Afghanistan.

zh.s: 蟒蛇行动又称沙伊科特战役，是2002年3月初阿富汗战争期间的一次军事行动。中情局准军事人员与盟友合作，试图消灭基地组织和塔利班部队。行动发生在佐尔马特东南方的沙伊科特山谷和阿尔马山脉。这是2001年后阿富汗战争中首次大规模战斗，此前最近的一场大型战斗是2001年12月的托拉博拉战役。
zh.n: 阿富汗战争：蟒蛇行动在阿富汗东部开始。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in South Africa on 1 March 2006, to elect members to the local governing councils in the municipalities of South Africa. The municipalities form the local government of South Africa and are subdivisions of the provinces, thus making them responsible for local service delivery, such as electricity, water and fire services. All major political parties, excepting the SACP who are members of the Tripartite alliance, fielded candidates in the election. The expected winner, the African National Congress (ANC) won the majority of seats nationwide, with 66.3% of the vote.

zh.s: 南非于2006年3月1日举行地方选举，选出各市政议会议员。市政机构是省以下的地方政府，负责供电、供水及消防等本地服务。除三方联盟成员南非共产党外，各主要政党均派候选人参选。被普遍看好的非洲人国民大会以66.3%的得票率，赢得全国多数议席。

en.s: The 2009 Carinthian state election was held on 1 March 2009 to elect the members of the Landtag of Carinthia. The election took place five months after the death of Governor Jörg Haider, long-time leader of the Freedom Party in Carinthia (FPK). He was succeeded by Gerhard Dörfler. The FPK had split from the Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) when Haider formed the Alliance for the Future of Austria in 2005, and without its veteran leader, the party's future was uncertain.

en.s: Mano Gai or Manogi airstrike refers to the killing of Afghan children in Mano Gai, Dara-I-Pech District, Kunar province, Afghanistan on March 1, 2011. The next day hundreds of Afghan villagers protested the killing chanting slogans against the United States and the Afghan government as they marched to the bombing site.

en.s: In the evening of March 1, 2014, a knife attack occurred inside the Kunming Railway Station in Kunming, Yunnan, China. At around 21:20, a group of 8 knife-wielding men and women attacked passengers at the city's railway station. Both male and female attackers pulled out long-bladed knives and stabbed and slashed passengers. At the scene, police killed four assailants and captured one injured female. The incident, targeted against civilians, left 29 civilians and 4 perpetrators dead with more than 140 others injured. In the afternoon of 3 March, police announced that the six-man two-woman group had been neutralized after the arrest of three remaining suspects.

en.s: The 2020 EFL Cup final was the final of the 2019–20 EFL Cup. It was played at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 1 March 2020, and contested by Aston Villa and Manchester City. It was Villa's first EFL Cup final since 2010, and City's third successive EFL Cup final and fifth in the past seven seasons. City won the match 2–1 to claim their third consecutive EFL Cup title.

en.s: The Battle of Kherson took place on 1 March 2022 on the southern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war. Russian forces captured the city on 1 March 2022 after brief combat with local territorial defense fighters, and then began a military occupation of the city. The fall of Kherson was a major defeat for Ukraine; Kherson was the only regional capital to be captured by Russian forces during the invasion.

en.s: The 2025 Elimination Chamber, also promoted as Elimination Chamber: Toronto (known as No Escape: Toronto in Germany), was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown, and one wrestler from WWE's developmental brand, NXT.
